messages:
lee: FYI scheduling a dry-run apply for release-2026.04 in the 20:30 UTC window. Scope: ALB target groups + small IAM tweak. Pin aws provider to 4.60.0 and terraform to 1.7.0 in branch release/2026-04/pin-providers.
jessica: SGTM. Can we canary eu-west-1 first? Last TG change caused slow drains.
lee: Canary plan = eu-west-1 -> us-west-2 -> global-common. Deploy-bot will preflight.
deploy-bot: Preflight started for release/2026-04/pin-providers at 2026-03-21T20:05:02Z. Running terraform plan -var-file=release-2026-04.tfvars workspace=release-2026-04.
chris: Plan shows aws_lb_target_group svc-api will be recreated due to default stickiness change. Anyone bumped module defaults?
ben: Module v2.9.0 added cookie-based stickiness by default. That causes replacement with provider 4.60.0.
jessica: Keep canary small and monitor healthchecks + latency.
lee: Approvals: @jessica @chris ack for canary at 20:30?
jessica: Ack. I'll monitor.
chris: Ack. I'll watch LB metrics.
ops-oncall: I'll stand by. Rollback triggers: healthy_host_count drop >30% or 5xx >1% sustained 3m -> rollback.
lee: Added triggers and set deploy-bot circuit-breaker to 1% 5xx for 3m. Bumped TG deregistration delay to 60s.
deploy-bot: Scheduled apply in 20 minutes. Waves: eu-west-1 -> us-west-2 -> global-common, 2m verification per wave.
lee: Running canary apply for eu-west-1: terraform apply -auto-approve -parallelism=1 -target=module.alb on branch.
ben: Apply output: "aws_lb_target_group.svc_api: Modifying...\nApply complete! Resources: 0 added, 1 changed, 0 destroyed."
chris: Post-apply: 5xx spike 0.2% -> 0.9% and slight tail latency increase. Investigating logs.
jessica: Paste last logs pls.
chris: Logs: 2026-03-21T20:33:26Z ERROR svc-api handler: upstream connection reset ; 2026-03-21T20:33:29Z WARN svc-api: sticky session cookie missing for request 9d3f.
ben: Aligns with cookie stickiness. Some backends don't set the cookie so requests hit bad targets.
lee: Circuit-breaker at 1% for 3m. Current 5xx 0.9% trending up. Hold or rollback?
ops-oncall: 5xx sustained -> 1.8% over 3m. Trigger hit. Abort wave 2 and rollback canary.
deploy-bot: Circuit-breaker tripped for eu-west-1 at 20:36:11Z. Aborting further waves and initiating rollback lane for eu-west-1.
lee: Rolling back: checkout revert/tg-stickiness and apply -target=module.alb to restore previous TG config.
ben: Rollback logs: "aws_lb_target_group.svc_api: Modifying...\nApply complete! Resources: 0 added, 1 changed, 0 destroyed."
chris: Post-rollback: 5xx dropped to 0.12% within 90s, healthy_host_count normal.
jessica: Root cause: upstream module changed stickiness default. Provider pin allowed default flip. Pin module version and add CI lint.
lee: Actions: merge revert/tg-stickiness, pin module version in infra root, add CI warning for implicit stickiness changes, update release notes: canary failed, global waves cancelled.
ops-oncall: Notifying product and security: "Canary apply for release-2026.04 in eu-west-1 caused TG stickiness change leading to transient 5xx spike; canary rolled back, global changes cancelled."
ben: Postmortem suggestion: integration test that sends cookie-less requests during canary to detect stickiness regressions.
lee: Agreed. I'll open follow-ups and bump priority. Closing thread after PR revert and notes updated. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
